facts.value: Official transcripts must be sent directly from the school to ASU (by mail or electronically), sealed in the original envelope if hand-delivered, and not faxed.
High school transcripts must include your GPA and graduation date.
Non-English transcripts must include an English translation.
Admission Services, Arizona State University, PO Box 870112, Tempe, AZ 85287-0112.
You can let a parent or guardian view your academic and financial records by going to the Profile tab in My ASU and clicking Add a Guest under Guest Access Permissions.
Each deferment is reviewed individually based on your reason for requesting it.
You will need an ASURITE User ID and password to log in to My ASU when returning after deferment. Your enrollment deposit will be posted to the term you are entering.
